name: B10-0132/2024 (ESN) – People’s Republic of China’s misinterpretation of the UN resolution 2758 and its continuous military provocations around Taiwan
title: People’s Republic of China’s misinterpretation of the UN resolution 2758 and its continuous military provocations around Taiwan
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on China, Taiwan and outside countries to avoid actions that change the current situation in the Taiwan Strait. It asks for calm, talks between the two sides, and no provocative military exercises or high-level visits. It also says the EU cannot offer military support in the region and should focus on diplomacy and trade, especially keeping supply chains like computer chips stable. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its position on Taiwan Strait tensions.
- It affects China, Taiwan, outside countries and EU trade in semiconductors.
- Next, the text goes to EU institutions, member states, China and the United Nations.
